request.body:
## Result and scope

Refs #194

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/194#issuecomment-6860707594, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-e4dd`.
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026 (package C15). The 18 C15 chapters named in #194, the two C15 part ledgers, and a new record `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C15/source-leakage-response.md`.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

This is the author response to all 67 C15 rows of the source-leakage audit #159 (42 B, 20 J, 5 ?). Every row is answered in the response table of `source-leakage-response.md`.

- **B (42):** each sentence is rewritten in ordinary mathematical language or deleted. Each caveat is either kept in the text, when it is mathematical (e.g. the ε ≤ 1/4 guard, standing conditions, order of choices), or moved to the record with its Lean names. Two moved caveats change what the text claims: the source's sequence-uniform choice in `input:trace-scales` (row 385), and field decay only at the postselected levels (row 393).
- **J (20):**
  - Row 294 is reclassified B (it introduces notation; the Lean expression `Z.β(k_i)` becomes ζ(k_i), as in the scribe chapter).
  - Row 409 is resolved by a one-line proof (t_i(1) → ∞ because p_i → ∞).
  - Row 380 is split. Two washout limits are referenced to YM-000034. The trace limit of the true correction is proved from the field receipt and continuity of the trace. The scale bounds and c_i¹ → −κ/4 become a named input.
  - All other J rows are now stated as outstanding inputs, not proved in the monograph. Existing names are reused (P1–P5, X1, E-clock, `C15-internal-planted-expansion`, the reference calibration). Six new names (I-C15-crown-witness, -frame-normalization, -eve-insertion-rate, -bill-label-receipt, -probe-scales, -scribe-scale-bounds, -finite-response-price) are entered in the part ledgers.
  - No argument was invented to fill a gap. For row 328 I did not identify the source's f with the envelope B_*, because the constants differ.
- **? (5):** four are B and edited. One (334, "source-placement") is N, because in that chapter "source" is the regular source term.
- One unflagged pointer to "the accompanying evidence file" in `trace-regular-atom.tex` is also removed (U1).

Still uncertain, and listed for the reviewer in the record:
- whether c_i¹ → −κ/4 is already supplied by YM-000033;
- whether the "effective coupling" q_i is the arch scale ζ(k_i), as l.613 and the part-B ledger say;
- 𝓔_k (core-to-strip map) is still undefined in the manuscript;
- the dotted constant names in `trace-local-rate-selection.tex` remain as notation.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Base `codex/existence-monograph` at `69b2631`. All 18 chapters were unchanged since the audit base `97128ab`, and their hashes match the C15 README handoff hashes.
- Commands actually run and results:
  - `latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -outdir=<scratch> existence.tex` (in `manuscript/`): exit 0, 982 pages, no undefined references. The one overfull box (1.83pt) is the existing one in `public-run-binding.tex`.
  - Changed passages located in the PDF text. Pages 895 and 942 were viewed as images; the rest were checked as text only.
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: `Blueprint structure OK: 4 units.`
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 tests OK.
  - `git diff --check`: clean.
- Checks not performed and why: no Lean elaboration (text reading only; no Lean-facing statement changes). Lean names in the moved correspondence come from the existing part ledgers. Only `Vault` and `Dust` (δ = 1/10000) were reopened, plus a grep for `teamW`, `penumbra`, `tiara` and `diadem`.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: no label is added, removed or renamed, and no theorem statement changes. Two subsection titles change (labels kept). Chapter hashes before and after are in the record. Any review fingerprint of YM-000026 covering these chapters is invalidated.

- [x] Source citations and hypotheses have been checked, where applicable.

- [x] The issue has a handoff and links to any durable Bots notes.

Required next review: mathematics (independent account), mainly of the J resolutions (rows 295, 298–301, 307, 324, 328, 358, 361–365, 372, 380, 402, 407, 409) and of the B rows that touch mathematical sentences.
